newsitem.title: CANADA: Funnel clouds, hail strike Manitoba - EC.
newsitem.headline: Funnel clouds, hail strike Manitoba - EC.

text.p: Funnel clouds and hail were reported throughout Manitoba's grainbelt late Thursday and Environment Canada investigated a possible tornado report.
Funnel clouds were reported in Portage-la-Prairie, MacGregor, Bagot, Carman and Birtle between 1515 and 1545 CDT, meteorologist Henry Rymarczuk said.
Lyleton, near the Saskatchewan-North Dakota border, saw baseball-sized hail that wiped out crops between 1700 and 1715 CDT, Rymarczuk said.
There were no reports as yet of injuries or fatalities but radio news reports said one car was flattened when a tree was uprooted.
Royal Canadian Mounted Police officials were not immediately available for comment.
Winds gusted up to 80 kmh (50 mph) at 1800 CDT northwest of Morris, he said.
A possible tornado was reported 14 km (9 miles) north of Gimli with ping-pong-ball-sized hail from 1815 to 1830 CDT.
Hail about three-quarters of an inch in diameter was reported in Lundar at 1935 CDT, he said.
Trees were uprooted by strong winds at 2000 CDT about 50 km (30 miles) east of Bissett, Rymarczuk said.
Gretna reported 13.4 mm (0.5 inch) of rain, he said.
